panels.description: Sanitizer-compatible navigation bus with native keyboard focus. Primary bus 0–4: Trust / Overview / Pipeline Diagnostics / Provider Health / Data Quality. Adjunct 5–6: Incident Workspace / Run Explorer. Current workspace is a non-interactive chip (aria-disabled + data-current=page, underlined) so active state is not color-only. Handoffs open same-tab, preserve current time range, and document scope reset or context mapping on cross-scope transitions. Chip colors are theme-safe for dark and light.

options.content: Which exact run should be inspected? BROWSE last 10, not this time range. Selected: $run_id. SELECTED RUN identity opens from the Run cell. Paths are report artifacts, not triage bodies.

panels.description: Run Explorer has two modes. Browse mode lists the last 10 run-report artifacts for the selected pipeline (disk index, not the dashboard time picker). Selected-run mode uses BioETL Ops HTTP under Selected Run Details to show identity, accounting, layers, timings/failure, reasons, and artifacts for one exact run. The time picker is for Identity coverage IN RANGE / OUT OF RANGE only. Default pipeline=unknown and run_id=- intentionally show no runs (not a missing data store and not a healthy run). Older than last 10: pick a concrete run_id from the catalog (not -). Then open Trust for recovery/replay safety. Run Explorer is evidence-only. Run ID is never a Prometheus label. Full filesystem paths belong to report-artifact Open/Copy actions. Run coverage: IN RANGE / OUT OF RANGE / UNKNOWN. Set range to run when OUT OF RANGE. Effective refresh: 60s · timezone: browser.

panels.title: Inspect Recent Runs (last 10)
panels.description: BROWSE · Last 10 on disk, not time-filtered; this index is not a SELECTED RUN snapshot. Latest ten pipeline-run reports found on disk for the selected pipeline. The dashboard time picker does not filter this table. Started is identity.started_at. Workflow is identity.workflow_id from that pipeline report (not the workflow-run catalog and not $workflow). Workflow run is identity.workflow_run_id (parent occurrence). $pipeline is a pipeline name (chembl_assay, chembl_target, chembl_publication), not a workflow (chembl_baseline). Workflow artifacts live under reports/run-reports/workflow/<name>/ and GET /ops/observability/workflow-run-reports. Click a Run cell to open that row's identity (viewPanel=3022) with pipeline, run_type, and run_id. The matching row is marked when $run_id is set. Pipeline and Workflow belong to each report row. Missing workflow linkage is explicit; full values are available through table inspection. Older runs: pick Run ID from the control-plane catalog (newest first); first screen is last 10 by design (limit=10). An empty table is valid when no matching reports exist for this pipeline (index_state=valid_empty). A TREE_MISSING / LAYOUT_UNHEALTHY / IDENTITY_UNHEALTHY row is bind or origin failure, not a selector problem — run python scripts/ops/runtime/docker/verify_report_bind.py from the checkout you are viewing. If reports are expected and the table is empty without that row, treat backend unavailable as a distinct failure and verify BioETL Ops HTTP at /health/live. SELECT RUN / VALID EMPTY is not OK.

defaults.noValue: VALID EMPTY — no pipeline-run-report artifacts for the selected pipeline under reports/run-reports/pipeline/<name>/ (first screen is last 10).

panels.title: Inspect Run Identity
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Identity rows for the selected run (control-plane table plus pipeline_run_report_v1 identity/tracking_coverage). Selection required when no run ID is set. VALID EMPTY means the selected run has no identity; backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR.

defaults.noValue: SELECT RUN — no exact Run ID selected. Choose a run first. VALID EMPTY if the selected run has no identity.

panels.title: Inspect Processed Records
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Complete Bronze/Silver/Gold accounting. Zero-valued outcomes remain evidence. SELECT RUN / VALID EMPTY is not OK. Counts and percentages are neutral accounting quantities, not quality verdicts. Exclusions alone have no severity threshold here; assess the DQ verdict and contract evidence. Percentages use the same precision (at least one decimal, up to three for small shares).

defaults.noValue: VALID EMPTY — selected run has no accounting rows. Select a Run ID first; backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR.

panels.title: Inspect Stage Funnel
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Selected run: Stage counts from pipeline_run_report_v1 for the selected run. This is a stage funnel, not start/end chronology. Removals is a compact reason summary; empty stages show — (not VALID EMPTY). VALID EMPTY is only when the report has no stage rows. Selection required when no run ID is set. Unexpected empty or errors require an Ops HTTP /health/live check. SELECT RUN / VALID EMPTY is not OK.

defaults.noValue: UNKNOWN — inspect the state row. SELECT RUN before choosing an exact run; VALID EMPTY only for a loaded report. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR.

panels.title: Inspect Top Run Reasons
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Selected run: Top removal and outcome reason codes recorded in pipeline_run_report_v1 for the selected run. Selection required when no run ID is set. Valid empty means the run recorded no reason rows; unexpected empty or errors require an Ops HTTP /health/live check. SELECT RUN / VALID EMPTY is not OK.

defaults.noValue: UNKNOWN — inspect the state row. SELECT RUN before choosing an exact run; VALID EMPTY only for a loaded report. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR.

panels.title: Inspect Run Artifacts
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Selected run: Artifact references recorded in pipeline_run_report_v1 for the selected run. The ref cell wraps so rows stay distinguishable; Copy still yields the full location. Selection required when no run ID is set. Valid empty means no artifacts were recorded; verify /health/live for unexpected empty or errors. SELECT RUN / VALID EMPTY is not OK.

defaults.noValue: UNKNOWN — inspect the state row. SELECT RUN before choosing an exact run; VALID EMPTY only for a loaded report. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR.

panels.title: Inspect Timings & Failure
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Optional pipeline_run_report_v1 failure and stage_timings blocks. Empty means those optional blocks were not recorded — not zero duration and not proof of success. Selection required when no run ID is set. VALID EMPTY / PARTIAL is not OK. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR.

defaults.noValue: VALID EMPTY — selected run report has no failure or stage_timings rows (optional blocks not recorded; not zero duration and not proof of success). Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR.

panels.title: Browse Workflow Runs
panels.description: Optional below-fold workflow-run-reports browser. Not first-screen. Does not change panel 3010.

panels.title: Inspect Recent Workflow Runs (last 20)
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Browse mode for workflow-run reports. $workflow is a workflow name (e.g. chembl_baseline), not a pipeline. This panel calls GET /ops/observability/workflow-run-reports?workflow=${workflow}&limit=20. Panel 3010 remains pipeline-only. An empty table is valid when no matching workflow reports exist (index_state=valid_empty). A TREE_MISSING / LAYOUT_UNHEALTHY / IDENTITY_UNHEALTHY row is bind or origin failure, not a selector problem — run python scripts/ops/runtime/docker/verify_report_bind.py from the checkout you are viewing. Backend unavailable is a distinct failure — verify BioETL Ops HTTP at /health/live. Null completed_at renders as — in the Completed cell; VALID EMPTY is the empty-table state only. SELECT RUN / VALID EMPTY is not OK.

defaults.noValue: VALID EMPTY — no workflow-run-report artifacts for the selected workflow under reports/run-reports/workflow/<name>/ (index is last 20).
